# fetched 2026-09-22. Figures copied from
# .capstan/effort/scout/session-log-format.md, section 7. Confidence there is

# the page verbatim, and one unrelated web search returned different numbers
# for a different-generation model it called "Sonnet 4.6". Re-check the live
# page before trusting a run's cost total.
# The pricing page quoted one "cache write" figure per model, not a 5-minute
# and a 1-hour figure separately. Both cache-write columns below repeat that
# one figure. Treat the cache_write_1h column as unconfirmed until the
# pricing page is checked again for a separate 1-hour rate.
# The model column must match a session's `message.model` string exactly, or
# session-usage reports that model as unpriced rather than guessing a match.
# claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5 below are confirmed `message.model`
# strings, read from real transcripts on this machine (see
# scout/session-log-format.md, section 3, and the Architect-supplied fact
# for subagent files). claude-haiku-4.5 and claude-fable-5.1 are this
# script's guess at the naming pattern, not confirmed against a real
# transcript; confirm both before trusting a run that used either model.
